5. Deviations from spec / findings the next briefing must absorb
- F-1 (briefing premise stale): CONT18 says control green, target red today. After F1b (fad3b88e1) CURRENT_APPROVAL_SCHEMA is plan-approval.v8, so :103 no longer selects a v7 record at all. v7-before shows BOTH the control and the target red with DAA-PUBLIC-UNAVAILABLE (a v7 record falls through to the pre-v7 branch). Rulings 117 and 130 state the same gap and assign it to F3.
- F-2 (consequence for the edit): swapping the readApprovedDesignWorkflowPackage call alone cannot turn v7 or DWP21 green. The selector at :103 must also select the v7 schema. Planned edit, three regions of the one file: (a) line 53 import readApprovedDesignWorkflowPackage becomes rereadApprovedDesignWorkflowPackage; (b) add const V7_APPROVAL_SCHEMA = "pipeline.plan-approval.v7" after the imports (the lib constant is not exported and plan-spec-state-v2.mjs is out of scope) and change the :103 test to approval?.schema === V7_APPROVAL_SCHEMA; (c) replace the :114-126 call with rereadApprovedDesignWorkflowPackage({ repoRoot: root, packagePath: approval.designWorkflowPackagePath, packageSha256: approval.designWorkflowPackageSha256, featureId, planPath, planSha256, specPath, specSha256, advisorExceptionBinding: approval.designWorkflowApproval?.advisorException ?? null }) dropping readCandidate from it (the const readCandidate stays, the signature branch passes it). Keep the :151 mode strings: DWP21 pins approved-workflow-package-signature, approved-workflow-package-chat and, for mini, not-required. v8 records then fall to the pre-v7 branch (refused, as today); F3b adds the v8 branch.
- F-3 (M2 cannot be met by this edit; stop condition 2/5 in waiting): node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/pipeline-state.mjs inspect on this repository was run (pre-edit). Its JSON (schema pipeline.inspect.v1: status implementing, lifecycle PLAN-LIFECYCLE-CURRENT) carries no design-approval admission or mode field, and pipeline-state.mjs has no reference to designAdvisoryAdmission, the re-read, or guard-devplan-policy. The briefed M2 ('inspect reports DWP2-LEGACY-APPROVED-REREAD valid') therefore cannot be produced by an edit to guard-devplan-policy.mjs. Also, designAdvisoryAdmission returns mode approved-workflow-package-signature (pinned by DWP21), while DWP2-LEGACY-APPROVED-REREAD is the mode of the re-read result itself. The Elephant must rule: re-define the M2 measurement (for example a read-only probe calling rereadApprovedDesignWorkflowPackage on the real r5d.package.json and quoting its mode) or assign the inspect surfacing to another slice.

The hand-back is deliberate: edit, after-captures (after-fast, after-hooks), consumer-safe check, add, commit and the terminal record need about 9 further calls; the dispatcher decides whether to grant budget or re-dispatch with F-1..F-3 in the briefing. - Closing-allowance statements: Committed: nothing committed. Verified green: none (hooks-before exit 0 is a baseline, not a result of this change).
